title: Improved account recovery for Loom users using Apple Private Relay
description: We’ve improved account recovery for Loom users who use Apple Private Relay and are moving to Atlassian-managed accounts. If an Atlassian account is already connected to another Loom account, we now detect the issue during their next sign in attempt and guide the user through creating a new Atlassian account. This helps prevent sign-in errors and makes it easier to regain access to Loom. No action is needed before the migration. The next time you sign in:
